name: code-generator
description: Generates code based on a task description, project context, and conventions. Outputs only the code, no explanations. Designed for small LLMs with focused context.

inputs.name: Task
inputs.description: What code to generate (e.g., 'Create a function that validates email addresses')

inputs.name: Context
inputs.description: Relevant project context (from context-builder): existing code, imports, patterns

inputs.name: Language
inputs.description: Target language (typescript, javascript, csharp, python). Auto-detected from context if not set.

inputs.name: Target File
inputs.description: File path where the code will be written (helps LLM match style)

outputs.name: Generated Code
outputs.description: The generated code ready to write to a file
